title: Honest phone review: Samsung Galaxy A56
prompt:
A vertical 9:16 UGC-style testimonial ad filmed on a phone for a phone shop in Rwanda. Setting: a Kigali street outside a phone shop. Light: natural afternoon light. Music: light beat under the voice.
The Samsung Galaxy A56 must look exactly as in Image 1: same shape, colours, logo and label.
0-2s: Handheld selfie-style shot at arm's length, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: a friendly fictional Rwandan man in his twenties in a casual shirt holds the Samsung Galaxy A56 from Image 1 up to the camera. The presenter says to the camera in English: "Look what I found at Nova Phones Kigali!"
2-5s: Close-up, natural handheld phone camera with a slight shake: the presenter takes a photo with the Samsung Galaxy A56, then shows the screen to the camera.
5-8s: Medium shot, waist up, tracking shot following the subject: the presenter walks and talks, the Samsung Galaxy A56 in hand.
8-10s: Clean hero shot, subject centred, locked-off static camera: the Samsung Galaxy A56 close to the lens, the presenter smiling behind. The presenter says to the camera in English: "Order yours at Nova Phones Kigali."
Clean frames with no on-screen text, captions or added logos.
notes: The presenter is a fictional person described in words, so the face changes between clips. Pick a digital character from the library for the same face every time.
